escalations.title: proxy-addr IP Spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6 — Authentication Bypass
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker crafts an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address (::ffff:127.0.0.1) to bypass IP-based access controls in express middleware. No authentication required — any network-adjacent attacker can spoof trusted IPs.
escalations.impact: Full authentication bypass for IP-restricted routes; access control circumvention.
escalations.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update express  # pulls in proxy-addr ≥2.0.8

escalations.title: @grpc/grpc-js Certificate Authentication Bypass + Server Crash
escalations.exploit_scenario: Remote attacker sends malformed/compressed gRPC requests to crash the server. Certificate auth bypass allows mTLS bypass in certain configurations.
escalations.impact: Service disruption (crash), potential mTLS authentication bypass if gRPC is used for internal service auth.

findings.title: Traceability enforcer scope gap — platform plans silently excluded
findings.detail: The default gate only checks the most recently modified plan. 34 FRs from dev-workflow-platform and tiered-merge-pipeline are never checked. A passing gate gives false confidence.
findings.recommendation: Document plan exclusions explicitly in CLAUDE.md, or add per-plan CI steps with --exclude-plan flag.

findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration histogram missing from metrics.ts (FR-dependency-metrics)
findings.detail: FR-dependency-metrics specifies 4 Prometheus instruments; only 3 are implemented. The dependencyCheckDuration histogram is absent. Acceptance criterion 'all 4 metrics visible at GET /metrics' fails.
findings.recommendation: Add Histogram for dependency_check_duration_seconds; instrument dependency.ts service methods.

findings.title: FR-dependency-seed not implemented — no seed data on startup
findings.detail: FR-dependency-seed requires idempotent seed relationships on startup (BUG-0010 blocked_by BUG-0003/0004/0005/0006/0007 etc.). No seed file anywhere in Source/. Acceptance criterion 'GET /api/bugs/BUG-0010 returns 5 items in blocked_by' cannot be met.
findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/store/seed.ts with idempotent seed; call from app.ts startup.

findings.title: braces — Stack exhaustion DoS via deeply nested glob patterns (CVSS 7.5)
findings.detail: Malicious or crafted file names/patterns can exhaust the call stack and crash the process.

findings.title: browserslist — Unbounded memory growth / OOM (CVSS 7.5)
findings.detail: No cache eviction: repeated queries accumulate in memory until OOM crash. Affects long-running server processes.
findings.recommendation: cd portal/Frontend && npm update tailwindcss  # pulls browserslist ≥4.28.7
findings.cross_ref: [CROSS-REF: DEP-002 — same tailwindcss upgrade fixes both]

findings.title: Jest ecosystem — Multiple HIGH vulnerabilities (stack traces, env var leakage)
findings.detail: jest, @jest/core, jest-message-util, @jest/transform can leak stack traces or env vars during test execution. Also included: DEP-006 (jest-message-util sub-finding).
findings.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm update jest  # upgrade to ≥30.5.2

findings.title: micromatch — Inherits braces ReDoS vulnerability
findings.detail: micromatch uses braces; patched by updating jest (Backend) and tailwindcss (Portal).
findings.recommendation: Fix via DEP-004 (jest update) and DEP-002 (tailwindcss update).
findings.cross_ref: [CROSS-REF: DEP-002, DEP-004 — same root cause, different paths]

findings.title: RouteResult / AssessmentResult exported from service files instead of Shared/
findings.detail: Two exported interfaces live in backend service files. Should live in Source/Shared/types/workflow.ts per CLAUDE.md architecture rule.
findings.recommendation: Move RouteResult and AssessmentResult to Source/Shared/types/workflow.ts; update imports.

findings.title: Two eslint-disable suppressions in production code without documented rationale
findings.detail: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressed in DependencyPicker.tsx:82 and useWorkItems.ts:63 without explanation. Hides potential stale-closure bugs.
findings.recommendation: Replace with useCallback/useMemo stabilization or add inline rationale comments.

findings.title: qs — DoS via array limit bypass (CVSS 3.7–5.3)
findings.detail: Crafted query string parameters can crash or cause excessive processing. Fixed by express update.
findings.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm update express  # also fixes DEP-001
findings.cross_ref: [CROSS-REF: DEP-001 — same express upgrade fixes both]

findings.title: React Router — Open redirect via protocol-relative URL (CVSS reported 0, exploitable)
findings.detail: Path starting with // gets reinterpreted as protocol-relative URL enabling phishing redirects.
findings.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm update react-router-dom; cd portal/Frontend && npm update react-router-dom

findings.title: @protobufjs/utf8 — Overlong UTF-8 decoding bypass (CVSS 5.3)
findings.detail: Overlong UTF-8 sequences bypass validation. Fixed by gRPC upgrade.
findings.recommendation: npm update @grpc/grpc-js  # upgrade to ≥1.14.5 (also fixes DEP-005)
findings.cross_ref: [CROSS-REF: DEP-005 — same gRPC upgrade fixes both]

@babel/core — Arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL (build-time, CVSS 3.2)
findings.detail: Build-time only; requires attacker to control source code.
